Service and oil change

Car service and oil change in Iskandar Puteri

Regular servicing keeps your engine clean, cool and reliable. We change the oil, check the car over and tell you what needs attention.

WhatsApp usCall

What this service covers

Engine oil lubricates, cools and cleans the moving parts inside your engine. Over time it breaks down and collects dirt. Hot weather and slow traffic make oil work harder, so servicing on time matters for cars in Johor. A proper service is more than an oil change. We also check the filters, fluids, belts and other wear items, so small problems are caught early. Bring your car to us at Taman Bukit Indah, near the Second Link. We serve drivers across Iskandar Puteri and JB.

Signs you need this

  • Service interval or oil change reminder shows on the dashboard
  • Engine sounds louder or rougher than it used to
  • Oil on the dipstick looks black, thick or gritty
  • Fuel use creeps up over a few months
  • Oil pressure or oil level warning light comes on
  • You do not remember when the last service was

What we do

  1. 01

    Inspect the car

    We check the oil level and condition, fluids, filters, belts and other wear items, and scan if needed.

  2. 02

    Explain what we found

    We tell you what is fine, what is wearing and what can wait, in plain words.

  3. 03

    Quote before work

    You get a quote for the service and any extra items. Nothing extra is done until you agree.

  4. 04

    Service the car

    We drain the old oil, fit the new oil and filter, and carry out the agreed service items.

  5. 05

    Re-check and test drive

    We check for leaks, top up fluids, reset the service reminder and test drive the car.

  6. 06

    Handover

    We hand back the car with a clear note on what was done and when to come back.

What's included and what we check

  • Engine oil and oil filter change
  • Oil level and leak check
  • Air filter condition
  • Brake fluid and coolant levels
  • Drive belt condition
  • Battery terminals and charge
  • Tyre condition and pressure
  • Service reminder reset

Questions drivers ask

How often should I change engine oil?

It depends on the oil type, the engine and how you drive. Your owner's manual gives a distance or time limit. Short trips and heavy traffic count as hard use. WhatsApp us your car model and we will advise. Heavy traffic and short trips count as hard use.

What is included in a car service?

At minimum, an oil and oil filter change plus a check of fluids, filters, belts, brakes and tyres. We tell you what we find and quote any extra work first, so you decide what to do.

Can I change oil without a full service?

Yes. You can do an oil change on its own. But a service also checks the parts around the engine, so we suggest at least a quick inspection at the same time. We will explain what we see. Skipping a check can hide a leak or a worn belt.

Which oil grade should my car use?

Use the grade and specification in your owner's manual, because engines are built for a certain type. We check the manual specification for your car and explain the choice before we start. Using the wrong oil can harm the engine over time.

How much does a service cost?

It depends on your car, the oil and filters it needs, and any extra items. We do not quote a fixed price here. WhatsApp 011-6776 1138 and we will give you a quote. Extra parts or fluids are quoted separately before we fit them.

How long does a service take, and can I wait?

It depends on the car and what the inspection finds. Please WhatsApp 011-6776 1138 or call to check before you come, and we will tell you what to expect for your car. We will not rush a service just to hit a time.
